page_2.details:
Silhouette: Wrap coat with fitted bodice and A-line flared skirt, asymmetrical maxi length
Sleeves: Long fitted sleeves with raglan-style ease and finished cuffs
Other Features:
Wide notched collar with structured lapels
Self-fabric tie belt at natural waist
Functional side seam pockets at hip level
Center front wrap closure with overlap construction

size_label.placement: Below or beside the brand label

care_label.placement: Inner left side seam, above 10–15 cm from the hem

page_3.label_notes: The color of the labels is white. Type of: 100% Recycled polyester woven label.

accessories.justification: Standard thread for wool gabardine construction. Polyester core spun provides strength and durability for high-stress seams (shoulders, sides, waist, pockets). Color matches fabric. Used for all lockstitch and overlock seaming.
accessories.description: Sewing Thread - 100% Polyester core spun (recycled polyester preferred)

accessories.placement: Inside back neck seam (centered at neckline)
accessories.justification: Mandatory brand identification. Positioned at interior neckline for visibility and standard placement in outerwear.
accessories.position: Inside back neck seam (centered at neckline)

accessories.placement: Inside left side seam, below waist seam
accessories.justification: Size designation label (S, M, L, XL). Standard placement in side seam for easy visibility during fitting. Woven label ensures durability through washing and dry cleaning.
accessories.position: Inside left side seam, below waist seam

accessories.material: Woven label with printed care instructions
accessories.placement: Inside left side seam, above size label
accessories.justification: Care and fiber content instructions required by FTC and international standards. Positioned in side seam for standard placement. Woven label with printed instructions ensures durability and legibility.
accessories.description: Care Label - Woven label with printed care instructions - 1" × 1.5"
accessories.position: Inside left side seam, above size label

seams.justification: Shoulder seams carry garment weight and support sleeve cap. Wool gabardine is stable and non-stretch; seam must be strong and visually clean. High QC strictness requires precise symmetry and tight stitching. Reinforced structural seam with clean finish.

seams.description: Structural, high stress from maxi length and A-line flare
seams.justification: Side seams experience significant stress from garment weight (maxi-length coat) and body movement. Visible on fitted silhouette. Wool gabardine requires strong seaming but does not need stretch accommodation. A-line flare from waist increases load on lower side seams. Reinforced structural seam with clean edge finish.

Center back seam is visible and load-bearing in maxi coat. Asymmetrical hemline (back 2–4 inches longer than front) requires precise seam alignment to maintain hem symmetry and garment balance. Wool gabardine is stable; no stretch needed. Reinforced structural seam with clean finish.

seams.seam_location: Center front seam with wrap overlap
seams.description: Structural, precision closure for wrap-front construction
seams.justification: Wrap-front construction requires precise overlap alignment for aesthetic and functional closure. Center front seam is visible and must maintain wrap integrity. Wool gabardine is stable; no stretch required. High QC strictness demands tight tolerance on overlap positioning. Clean structural seam with precise overlap alignment.

Armhole experiences high stress from arm movement and sleeve weight. Fitted sleeve cap requires precise ease distribution. Wool gabardine is stable but requires careful seaming to prevent puckering at curve. No stretch needed due to semi-fitted design and stable fabric. Reinforced structural seam with controlled ease.

Long fitted sleeves are visible and require clean seaming for professional appearance. Wool gabardine is stable; no stretch needed. Fitted construction demands precise sleeve cap and seam line alignment. Clean structural seam with precise alignment.

seams.description: Load-bearing, supports tie belt and A-line flare
seams.justification: Waist seam is load-bearing: supports self-fabric tie belt weight and anchors A-line flare from waist. High stress from garment weight and belt tension. Wool gabardine is stable; no stretch needed. Reinforcement required to prevent seam slippage or distortion. Reinforced structural seam with stable positioning.

seams.description: Structural, high stress from hand insertion
seams.justification: Functional side pockets experience high stress from repeated hand insertion and potential weight loading. Pocket openings must be reinforced to prevent tearing or distortion. Wool gabardine is stable; no stretch needed. Clean finish required for visible pocket edges. Reinforced structural seam with clean edge finish.

Wrap-front construction creates slit opening at center front. Slit edges must be reinforced to prevent fraying and maintain wrap integrity. Visible design feature requires clean, precise edge finish. Wool gabardine is stable; no stretch needed. Clean finish seam with reinforced slit edges.

Notched collar with structured lapels is a design-critical feature visible at neckline. Requires clean, precise edge finish and stable seaming. Wool gabardine supports structured collar without stretch. High QC strictness requires sharp collar points and even lapel width. Clean finish seam with structured collar and lapel support.

Cuff openings are visible and experience moderate stress from hand movement. Wool gabardine is stable; no stretch required. Clean finish prioritized for professional outerwear aesthetic. Clean finish seam with precise edge definition.

seams.description: Asymmetrical maxi hemline, front and back
seams.justification: Maxi-length coat with asymmetrical hemline (back 2–4 inches longer than front) requires precise hem length control and clean finish. Visible from multiple angles. High QC strictness demands tight tolerance on hem length differential. Wool gabardine is stable; no stretch accommodation needed. Clean finish hem with precise length control.

seams.description: Raw edge finish on all structural seams
seams.justification: Wool gabardine (280–320 GSM) is prone to fraying at cut edges. Overlock finish on all interior seam allowances prevents fraying and extends garment durability. Applied after primary seaming to seal raw edges. Standard practice for premium outerwear construction.

measurements.description: 1/2 circumference, primary fit control for wrap coat silhouette
measurements.justification: Primary fit control for wrap coat silhouette. Semi-fitted construction requires precise bust measurement to ensure wrap overlap alignment and proper drape across chest. Tight tolerance prevents gaping at wrap closure.

Defines tie-belt closure position and wrap overlap point. Critical for wrap coat construction where waist definition controls silhouette and closure functionality. Precise waist measurement ensures belt sits at correct anatomical position.

Controls A-line flared skirt portion and overall silhouette. Maxi wrap coat requires precise hip measurement to maintain intended flare and drape from waist. Hip measurement determines hem sweep and silhouette proportion.

measurements.description: Shoulder-to-shoulder width, structured collar and sleeve cap placement
measurements.justification: Fit-critical measurement for structured collar, notched lapels, and sleeve cap placement. Tight tolerance required as variation affects collar alignment and shoulder seam position. Precise shoulder width ensures collar symmetry and lapel proportion.

measurements.description: Sleeve cap fit and comfort control
measurements.justification: Controls sleeve cap fit and comfort. Semi-fitted wrap coat with set-in sleeve requires precise armhole depth to prevent binding or excess fabric. Tight tolerance ensures consistent arm movement and sleeve cap ease distribution.

measurements.description: Shoulder seam to cuff opening, long sleeve proportion
measurements.justification: Long sleeve construction requires precise length for proper wrist coverage and proportion. Maxi coat silhouette demands consistent sleeve-to-hem ratio. Sleeve length affects overall garment proportion and visual balance.

measurements.description: Front maxi length, primary reference for asymmetrical hemline
measurements.justification: Defines maxi length and wrap coat proportions. Asymmetrical hemline (front shorter than back) requires strict front length control for design intent. Front hem length is primary reference for maxi silhouette.

measurements.description: Back maxi length, 2–4 inches longer than front
measurements.justification: Back length is 2–4 inches (5–10 cm) longer than front per design specification. Asymmetrical hemline is signature design feature requiring strict tolerance to maintain intended silhouette. Back hem length differential is critical design element.

measurements.description: Center front closure area, wrap integrity control
measurements.justification: Wrap front construction requires precise overlap measurement to ensure proper closure alignment and tie-belt functionality. Tight tolerance prevents gaping or excess overlap. Overlap width determines wrap integrity and visual closure appearance.

Notched collar with structured lapels requires precise neck opening for proper collar stand and lapel lay. Fit-critical for structured neckline. Neck opening measurement ensures collar sits correctly at base of neck.

Structured collar component requires tight tolerance to maintain notched collar design intent and lapel proportion. Not graded across sizes to preserve collar structure consistency. Collar height is design-critical and must remain constant.

Long sleeve opening must accommodate wrist and hand movement. Standard tolerance allows for comfort while maintaining sleeve proportion. Sleeve opening circumference ensures functional wrist fit without excess fabric.

measurements.description: 1/2 circumference at hem, front A-line flare
measurements.justification: A-line flared skirt requires controlled hem sweep for intended silhouette. Front hem sweep must coordinate with back hem for asymmetrical design. Front hem sweep determines A-line flare proportion and silhouette volume.

measurements.description: 1/2 circumference at hem, back A-line flare
measurements.justification: Back hem sweep is larger than front due to A-line flare and longer back length. Maxi coat requires controlled sweep for proper drape and movement. Back hem sweep is larger to accommodate longer back length and A-line flare.

measurements.description: Side seam pocket opening width, functional design
measurements.justification: Functional side pockets require consistent opening width for usability and design proportion. Not graded to maintain pocket functionality across sizes. Pocket opening width ensures hand access and functional pocket design.

measurements.description: Side seam pocket depth, hand placement
measurements.justification: Functional side pockets require adequate depth for hand placement. Not graded to ensure consistent pocket functionality. Pocket depth ensures adequate hand storage capacity.

measurements.description: Self-fabric belt full length, wrap and tie functionality
measurements.justification: Self-fabric tie belt must be long enough to wrap and tie at waist. Slightly larger tolerance allows for tie adjustment and styling flexibility. Tie belt length must accommodate wrapping around waist and tying at front.

measurements.description: Reference measurement for pattern alignment and seam placement
measurements.justification: Center back seam with fitted sleeve cap requires measurement for pattern alignment and seam placement. Reference measurement for construction verification. Center back seam length ensures proper back bodice proportion and sleeve cap alignment.

fabrics.position: Outer body, sleeves, collar, lapels, tie belt
fabrics.justification: Pure wool gabardine selected as primary outerwear fabric per brand specification. Structured, non-stretch composition supports wrap-front construction, notched collar with lapels, and A-line silhouette. High GSM appropriate for winter maxi coat. Matte finish suits professional outerwear aesthetic. Dimensional stability critical for precise hem alignment and wrap overlap tolerance control mandated by high QC strictness.

quality_standards.requirements: Max ±2% shrinkage in length and width
quality_standards.comments: 100% wool gabardine requires strict dimensional stability control. Maxi-length wrap coat with asymmetrical hemline (back 2-4 inches longer than front) demands precise shrinkage tolerance to maintain hem alignment and wrap overlap positioning. High QC strictness requires tight control.
Wool gabardine outerwear requires color stability during laundering or dry cleaning. Prevents dye bleeding that could compromise garment appearance or stain lining/undergarments.

Dyed wool gabardine must resist color transfer during wear, particularly at contact points (wrap overlap, belt, sleeves). Wet rubbing critical for winter outerwear exposed to moisture and perspiration.

Complex construction with multiple high-stress seams: reinforced shoulder, side, center back, waist (load-bearing for tie belt), and pocket openings. Heavy wool gabardine (280-320 GSM) requires strong seaming to prevent seam slippage under garment weight and wear stress.

quality_standards.requirements: No visible shrinkage, color change, or seam distortion
quality_standards.comments: Maxi-length wrap coat with structured collar and lapels must maintain shape, hem alignment, and closure integrity after care. Asymmetrical hemline and wrap overlap require visual inspection for dimensional changes.

Winter outerwear experiences high abrasion at contact points: wrap overlap, belt friction at waist, sleeve cuffs, and pocket openings. Wool gabardine must resist pilling and surface wear from repeated friction and body movement.

Wool gabardine is a smooth, tightly woven fabric prone to seam slippage under stress. Critical for high-stress seams: side seams (support maxi-length coat weight), waist seam (supports tie belt), and pocket openings (hand insertion stress). High QC strictness requires tight tolerance.

Heavy wool gabardine (280-320 GSM) must demonstrate adequate fabric strength to support garment weight and construction stress. Ensures fabric integrity throughout maxi-length coat with complex seaming and load-bearing waist seam.

wash_label.washing_instructions: Dry clean only. Do not wash.
wash_label.drying_instructions: Lay flat to dry. Do not tumble dry.
wash_label.ironing_instructions: Warm iron on wool setting. Use pressing cloth. Do not iron directly on fabric.

dry_cleaning.line_2: Use mild solvent. Avoid excessive agitation.

standards: FTC Care Labeling Rule (16 CFR Part 423)
ASTM D5489 (Standard practice for care labeling of consumer textiles)
wash_label.justification: 100% wool gabardine outerwear requires dry cleaning only to preserve fabric structure, color, and finish. Wool is sensitive to water and agitation. Matte finish and structured construction (collar, lapels) require professional care. Care label must comply with FTC and ISO standards for consumer protection.

care_label_instructions: The care label must contain carelabel symbols and those only.
Care label must be made in recycled polyester.
Care labels must contain origin: made in India.
Care labels must be given the same size, font and style.

other_standards.title: Standard 100 by Oekotex
other_standards.description: Label that ensures consumers that all materials used in a garment are tested for harmful substances.

other_standards.title: EU Ecolabel
other_standards.description: Label that ensures consumers that textiles are made using less harmful substances, energy and water.

other_standards.title: Bluesign
other_standards.description: The Bluesign System reduces impact on people and the environment in the entire textile supply chain, based on input stream management.
